'''2011 Worlds Day 2 Adam Beauchamp DS Imperial Occupation''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Adam Beauchamp]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck '''Walkers, Texas Ranger''' / username '''Umpass'''. Line 27 sheet fighter shorthand expanded best-effort.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Imperial Occupation|Imperial Occupation (V)]]
* '''Username:''' Umpass
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
